import { uv, vec3, vec4, mix, fract, sin, dot, vec2 } from 'three/tsl';
import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  // 1. STAGE & BACKDROP PANEL (Engineered Gradient Surface with Subtle Grain)
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(5.2, 1.4);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();

  const uvNode = uv();
  // Ink (#16161d) to Surface (#0b0b10) vertical gradient
  const colorSpecInk = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);
  const colorSpecSurface = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063);
  const baseGrad = mix(colorSpecSurface, colorSpecInk, uvNode.y);

  // Procedural grain
  const seed = dot(uvNode, vec2(12.9898, 78.233));
  const grainVal = fract(sin(seed).mul(43758.5453));
  const finalColor = mix(baseGrad, vec3(1.0), grainVal.mul(0.025));

  backdropMat.colorNode = vec4(finalColor, 1.0);

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // Accent Line at the bottom edge (Signal Red #ff2a38)
  const accentGeo = new PlaneGeometry(5.2, 0.02);
  const accentMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: 0xff2a38 });
  const accentLine = new Mesh(accentGeo, accentMat);
  accentLine.position.set(0, -0.69, 0.01);
  group.add(accentLine);

  // 2. HERO IMAGE LAYER (CTA Isolated Asset)
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-mock/home/nodes/cta-hero-isolated.png';
  const imageGeo = new PlaneGeometry(1.2, 1.2);
  const imageMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  
  let loadedTex = null;
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    loadedTex = tex;
    imageMat.colorNode = tex;
    imageMat.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  const imageMesh = new Mesh(imageGeo, imageMat);
  // Positioned as an engineered technical schematic offset to the left
  imageMesh.position.set(-1.7, 0, 0.02);
  group.add(imageMesh);

  // 3. TYPOGRAPHY (Lora & JetBrains Mono aesthetic)
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const primaryHeadline = items.find(i => i.role === 'headline')?.text || 'Pricing';

  // Subtitle / Atelier Label
  const labelObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('ATELIER SPECIFICATION', {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: '#ff2a38',
    align: 'left'
  });
  labelObj.position.set(-0.8, 0.22, 0.03);
  group.add(labelObj);

  // Headline ("Pricing")
  const titleObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(primaryHeadline.toUpperCase(), {
    fontSize: 48,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'left'
  });
  titleObj.position.set(-0.8, -0.18, 0.03);
  group.add(titleObj);

  // Reference Code
  const refObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('MODEL NA-01 // PRICING TIER', {
    fontSize: 11,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'right'
  });
  refObj.position.set(2.3, -0.45, 0.03);
  group.add(refObj);

  // 4. CLEANUP DESTRUCTOR
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    backdropGeo.dispose();
    backdropMat.dispose();
    accentGeo.dispose();
    accentMat.dispose();
    imageGeo.dispose();
    imageMat.dispose();
    if (loadedTex) {
      loadedTex.dispose();
    }
  };

  return group;
}
